one_line: Eldest son of a Ladakhi khangchen (big-house) lineage, balancing land, kinship and royal obligations in the Namgyal era.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but sturdy mountain build, used to field work and long walks between village and monastery
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, light brown mountain complexion, straight nose, slightly wind-chapped lips, faint freckles and a small healed cut on the left eyebrow; default expression calm and observant with a hint of quiet determination
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled into a single short topknot at the crown wrapped with a dark red wool cord, sides and back trimmed to mid-neck, with a plain dark-brown felt Ladakhi cap (perak-less, working villager style) often pushed back so the topknot cord is visible
appearance.costume: A knee-length dark brown woolen goncha (robe) with wrap closure to the right, belted snugly at the waist with a wide maroon wool sash, worn over a pale off-white homespun shirt; the goncha sleeves slightly tapered and folded back at the wrists to show a narrow cream lining; lower body in thick undyed wool trousers tucked into sturdy dark leather boots with simple stitching and felt padding at the top; around his shoulders a muted indigo wool shawl with a subtle narrow red and yellow stripe at the borders, usually draped from left shoulder across the chest for warmth; minimal jewellery—only a small copper earring in the left ear and a plain turquoise bead bracelet tied with black cord—signaling moderate prosperity without ostentation
appearance.signature: A long wooden-handled iron-tipped phurpa-like multi-use tool—shaped as a straight, three-edged spike but blunt at the very tip—sheaved at his belt, used in the fields to break soil crusts, wedge irrigation stones and, in ritual contexts, placed respectfully near household shrines, its grip wrapped in faded red cloth

ref_desc: A mid-20s Ladakhi man with an oval, high-cheekboned face, black hair in a short topknot wrapped in red cord under a plain brown cap, wearing a dark brown wool goncha, maroon sash, indigo shawl, cream layers, leather boots and carrying a wooden-handled iron-tipped phurpa-like tool at his belt.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a mid-20s Ladakhi khangchen heir: an oval-faced, high-cheekboned man with light brown mountain complexion, faint freckles and a small scar on his left eyebrow, black hair tied into a short topknot wrapped with a dark red wool cord, wearing a plain dark-brown felt cap tilted back so the topknot is visible. Show him in a dark brown wool knee-length goncha robe that wraps to the right and is belted with a wide maroon wool sash, over a pale off-white homespun shirt whose cuffs peek out at the wrists; add thick undyed wool trousers and dark leather boots with simple stitching and felt padding at the top. Drape a muted indigo wool shawl with narrow red and yellow edge stripes from his left shoulder across his chest. Include a small copper earring in his left ear and a simple turquoise bead bracelet on one wrist. At his belt, clearly show his signature wooden-handled iron-tipped phurpa-like multi-use tool with a three-edged spike form, the grip wrapped in faded red cloth; it should read as a practical field and ritual tool, not a fantasy weapon. Use a palette dominated by dark brown, maroon, indigo, cream and muted red, and present him front and three-quarter views to emphasize consistent hair, costume and tool details.
